# Prism speech library

This build uses the unmodified Prism 0.18.2 Windows x64 dynamic release from
https://github.com/ethindp/prism/releases/tag/v0.18.2.

Prism is licensed under MPL 2.0. Its corresponding source is available at
https://github.com/ethindp/prism/tree/f237af67d0460a6dad312cc446623856ad823c50.
Prism and dependency licenses accompany this notice.

The release archive SHA-256 is
`31c02e3ef2260b4d3b11fb00132f8eb12bc147b5fb17031b580670b117ba7d23`.

Prism uses simdutf, Moderncom, dr_wav, concurrentqueue, fmt, Highway and NVDA
controller RPC definitions. See the accompanying upstream license files for
attribution and terms. Prism's upstream NOTICE states that the NVDA controller
IDL and generated outputs may also be used under MPL 2.0 with permission.
